extracted.name: Caramel Apple Dip
extracted.description: This light and fluffy Caramel Apple Dip couldn't be easier to make using cream cheese, caramel sauce, and whipping cream.
ingredient_lines: 1/3-1/2* cup caramel sauce (, homemade or store bought)
4 ounces cream cheese (, softened, cut into pieces)
instruction_lines: Beat the cream cheese in a stand mixer or large mixing bowl, until smooth. Add the cream and mix well until stiff peaks form, about 3 minutes.
Mix in cinnamon, vanilla, sugar and caramel sauce until combined.
Serve with apple slices. Refrigerate leftovers.
